1\. Task-base updates can leave the suite stale 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
cmd_pin now rewrites the suite pin when a suite exists, but the task-base workflow summary still
instructs maintainers to stage only task-base.json. Following that command commits the new image
pin without the suite change, and verification of the resulting checkout rejects the old
runtime.task_base.
